Card credits

American Express Hilton Honors Aspire credits and when they expire

Every statement credit on the American Express Hilton Honors Aspire (annual fee $550), what it is worth, and when it resets. Last verified October 2, 2026.

CreditAmountResets
Hilton resort credit$200 every six monthsTwice a year: Jun 30 and Dec 31
Flight credit$50 per quarterEvery quarter: Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31
CLEAR+ credit$219 per yearEvery calendar year (Dec 31)
Free night rewardA perk (no dollar value)Every year, on your card anniversary

If you used every recurring credit above in a full year, that adds up to about $819 against the $550 annual fee. Most people use only some of them, which is why tracking matters.

Details come from the issuer's public terms and reputable reviews, and issuers change credits often. Always confirm the current terms with your issuer before relying on a credit. PerkaBoo is not affiliated with any card issuer or bank.
